title: The Sleep Recording
narration: My sleep app recorded me confessing to a murder I couldn't remember. The recording said I buried my therapist beneath his greenhouse. He appeared there alive and admitted planting confessions in my sleeping mind so I would depend on him. I secretly recorded his admission, but he smiled and asked whether I still believed I was holding my own phone. Its screen changed to a bedroom camera. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. Every explanation I tried made the details worse, because each clue had been placed where I alone would find it. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. I was still asleep there, hearing my own voice command me to wake up and kill him.
